_doc: The townspeople's Pokémon (companions.gd): who they belong to, where they sleep, what they say. Lines: the player talks to them (A): 'talk' by mood ('asleep', 'happy', 'any', a period of the day), 'owner_talk' (the owner's line when near, by the same keys; a list of strings or [strings] for two lines), 'quest' by quest state ('<quest id>:active' | ':done') and flag; 'barks' over its head now and then; 'owner_barks' the owner says to it. A companion with 'home': 'pallet_house' (Mr. Mime, mime_life.gd) lives and works there instead of following: 'schedule' = his own day while the owner is away ([HH:MM, job, spot]; jobs sleep, sweep, water, tidy, practice, bench; spots nook, porch, terrace, garden, roses, fence, bench from places.json pallet_house), 'jobs' = each job's task, duration range [min, max] s, carried prop and table / seat height 'th'; 'mimes' = [mood, line] when the player talks to him; 'owner_chat' = [the owner's line, his mimed answer] when they hang out; 'hello' / 'goodbye' = the owner's lines as she arrives and leaves.

any: NIBBLES: Cater! Cater!
(Nibbles waves his little front feet at you.)
NIBBLES: Caaater?
(He tilts his head. His red horn wobbles.)
NIBBLES: Cater-cater!
(He wriggles happily.)
(Nibbles is busy nibbling something. Probably a leaf. Probably.)
NIBBLES: ...Cater.
morning: (He smells of fresh leaves and morning dew.)
asleep: (Nibbles is curled up asleep in the Caterpie Corner.)
(Nibbles is fast asleep. His horn twitches. Dreaming of leaves?)

any: LILY: That's Nibbles! He likes you, Ash. I can tell.
LILY: Don't poke him! Farmer Ben says Caterpie don't like being poked.
LILY: Nibbles, say hello! ...He said hello.
LILY: Did you know Caterpie have little feet? Sixteen of them!
LILY: Well. I counted six. But the book says sixteen.
morning: LILY: Nibbles ate a whole leaf this morning. A WHOLE one!
evening: LILY: Shh. Nibbles gets sleepy at supper time.
asleep: LILY: Shh! He's sleeping. Butterfree need lots of sleep. Caterpie too.

q_butterfree:active: (Nibbles looks up at you. He seems... fine? It's hard to tell with Caterpie.)
butterfree_tips: (Nibbles looks plump, shiny and very content. Lily's been talking to him every day.)

q_butterfree:active: LILY: See? Is that a happy face? I can't tell! That's why I need your help, Ash!
butterfree_tips: LILY: I tell him about my whole day now. He listens SO well. He's going to be the best Butterfree ever.

companions.name: Mr. Mime
mimes: polish
(Mr. Mime mimes polishing an invisible window, then waves.)
wall
(Mr. Mime presses his palms flat against the air. There's a wall between you. He looks very sorry about it.)
box
(Mr. Mime finds himself trapped in an invisible box. He feels along every side, then pops the lid and bows.)
rope
(Mr. Mime hauls on an invisible rope, hand over hand. Whatever's on the end must be heavy. Then he hands you the end.)
bow
(Mr. Mime bows deeply, one hand on his heart, as if you were the most important guest at PALLET HOUSE.)
wave
(Mr. Mime waves both hands. Then one. Then a tiny wave with one finger, just for you.)
laugh
(Mr. Mime laughs without a sound, holding his tummy, at a joke you didn't hear.)
shrug
(Mr. Mime looks at you, looks at the sky, and shrugs. Some things just are.)
talk
(Mr. Mime mimes a small boy, very short, toddling about. Then points at you. Then makes himself very tall. Then points at you again.)
talk
(Mr. Mime mimes a POKé BALL, throws it, and watches it fly away over the sea. He shades his eyes. He waves goodbye to it.)
clap
(Mr. Mime claps silently. You're not sure what for, but you'll take it.)

asleep: (Mr. Mime is curled up in his basket by the door, fast asleep.)
(Mr. Mime is asleep. His fingers are still miming something. A broom, maybe.)
busy: (Mr. Mime holds up one finger: just a moment.)
(He finishes, then gives you a little bow.)

any: MOM: Say hello, Mr. Mime! ...He says hello.
MOM: Mr. Mime's been with us since you were a baby, Ash.
MOM: He taught you to wave before you could walk.
MOM: Don't let him trap you in a box again, sweetie. It took you an hour to get out last time.
MOM: He's a better waiter than I'll ever be a cook.
MOM: Don't tell him I said so.
asleep: MOM: Shh. Let him sleep. He's swept that terrace a dozen times today.

owner_barks: Did you sweep the steps again? You're a dear.
owner_chat: Mr. Mime, did you see the sunrise? All pink and gold.
Do you think Ash will be all right out there, Mr. Mime?
Old Tom says the soup needs more salt. Old Tom says that about the sea.
We need more basil. Could you...? Oh, you already did. Of course you did.
Remember when Ash was little and you'd hide behind the invisible wall?
Rose wants the tart recipe. I told her it's a family secret. Which family, she said. Ours, I said. You included.
Ash is getting so big. You'll keep an eye on him for me, won't you? From up here?
Mr. Mime, what would you say if you could talk? ...That's what I thought.
goodbye: See you tomorrow, Mr. Mime! Lock up for me?
Night, Mr. Mime! Don't sweep all night!
I'm off home. Look after the place!
hello: Morning, Mr. Mime! Did you sleep well?
There you are! Ready for another day?

any: DODUO: Do-do!
(Both heads look at you. Then at each other. Then at you again.)
DODUO: Do! ...Duo!
(The left head says Do. The right head says Duo. They seem to disagree about something.)
DODUO: Dodo-do!
(One head pecks at your shoelace. The other pretends it didn't see.)
DODUO: Do-do? Do-DO!
(The heads squabble over who gets to say hello.)
morning: (Doduo is very awake. Both of it.)
asleep: (Doduo is asleep in the farmyard, one head tucked under the other's chin.)
(One head is asleep. The other opens an eye and watches you. Then closes it.)

any: FARMER BEN: Easy, Doduo.
FARMER BEN: Two heads, one stomach. Always hungry, the pair of 'em.
FARMER BEN: Doduo don't let just anyone near.
FARMER BEN: They let you. Mm.
FARMER BEN: Get off the berries, you.
morning: FARMER BEN: Up before me, this one. Every day.
asleep: FARMER BEN: Let 'em sleep. Long day in the furrows.
